name: Bank of America Home Loans (mortgage & HELOC)
notes: Researched from public bankofamerica.com Home Loan FAQs and the Home Loan Assistance site only. Managed in Online/Mobile Banking: Pay & Transfers tab for one-time or recurring payments (no additional charge); PayPlan automatic debits from checking or savings (no charge): Accounts Overview > Mortgage > Enroll in PayPlan; change monthly PayPlan via Manage PayPlan in the Payment Due section; drafts within three business days may not be changeable; PayPlans drafting more than once a month must be changed by calling 800-669-6607. Mortgage Pay by Web handles extra principal. Payoff quote: Help & Support > Mortgages, Loans and Lines of Credit > Request a payoff (free). Form 1098 in Statements & Documents; automated 1098 line 866-669-6607. Assistance 800-669-6650. Sign-in field labels (Online ID/Passcode) are well known but not stated on these pages (inferred). Grace period and late fee not stated (not modelled).

autopay.note: PayPlan has no charge. Plans that draft more than once a month are changed by phone at 800-669-6607.

autopay_cancel.note: Payments drafting within three business days may not be changeable.

help.title: Paying your home loan
paragraphs: In Online Banking, use the Pay & Transfers tab to make a one-time payment or schedule automatic recurring payments from an eligible account at no additional charge. Extra principal can be paid through Mortgage Pay by Web and is applied after the current month's full payment.
For other ways to pay, call 800-669-6607, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET.

help.title: PayPlan automatic payments
paragraphs: PayPlan debits your mortgage payment automatically from your checking or savings account, at no charge.

To change a monthly PayPlan, log in, select the home loan on the Accounts Overview screen, click Manage PayPlan in the Payment Due section, make your changes and select Continue. A payment drafting within three business days may not be changeable. If your PayPlan drafts more than once a month, call 800-669-6607 to change it.
PayPlan may not be available for every account, including FHA and VA loans.
steps: On Accounts Overview, select your mortgage.
On Account Details, select Enroll in PayPlan and follow the instructions.

help.title: Request a payoff quote
paragraphs: Payoff statements are free and can be mailed to you or to someone you authorize. For an online quote, go to Help & Support, select Mortgages, Loans and Lines of Credit, then select Request a payoff. To pay off early, call 800-669-6607.

help.title: Form 1098
paragraphs: If you paid $600 or more in interest, Form 1098 is mailed by the end of January, or delivered electronically if you enrolled. It is also on the Statements & Documents tab. If you do not have it by February 15, request a copy from the 24-hour automated line at 866-669-6607.

help.title: Home Loan Assistance
paragraphs: If you are having trouble paying, options to stay in your home include forbearance for temporary hardships and loan modification to make payments more affordable; home equity loans and lines can be modified too. Short sale and deed in lieu can settle the debt if you need to leave.
Call 800-669-6650, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET, with help in many languages.

extra.intent: Using the Bank of America help pages, find where in Online Banking to request a mortgage payoff quote, and whether payoff statements cost anything. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
